label: Mid-input positions (t=4-5) in sequences starting with e or with k at position 1/2
explanation: Fires only on input-phase steps 3-7 (about 87% of mass at t=4-5), plus weakly at the delimiter, and never during copy. The position window alone gives 97% recall but only 5% precision. Within that window the feature depends on which tokens came earlier: a first token of e (7.8x lift, 38% of mass) and k at position 1 or 2 (prev2_tok=k 5.3x) raise both how often it fires and how strongly. The top activations (~3.0) all start with e and have k in positions 1-2, e.g. e 3 k j b n. Digits 2/3 and b/j two steps back help more weakly. Prefers first occurrences of a token (in_first=1 holds 86% of mass). Silent at t<3, at t>=8 and throughout copy. The prefix-token dependence is spread over many tokens, so precision stays limited (dev F1 0.42).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=e (+4.44), orig1=k (+4.37), orig2=k (+3.67), t=4 (+2.71), t=5 (+2.54), prev_tok=i (+2.37). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-8.97), phase=2 (-6.77), t=8 (-6.55), orig0=i (-6.45).
